blocks.text: Essential slack keyboard shortcuts for mac

As a search engine evaluator, your time is your most valuable asset. Every second spent clicking through menus is a second away from a task. Learning keyboard shortcuts is the best way to speed up your Slack usage on a Mac.

items: Command + K: Opens the quick switcher to jump to any conversation.
Command + /: Displays the full list of keyboard shortcuts.
Command + G: Initiates a general search across your workspace.
Command + F: Searches for messages within your current channel.

blocks.text: Evaluators often work in blocks of time. You need to signal when you are busy rating search results and when you are available for project updates. Keeping your status updated prevents unnecessary interruptions during deep work sessions.
Use the /dnd command followed by a time to pause all notifications until you finish your current batch of evaluations.
blocks.title: Quick notification pause

blocks.text: Your Mac should be an extension of your evaluation process. If you find yourself checking Slack too often, consider using the desktop app's sidebar settings to group unread messages. This allows you to process communication in one go rather than reacting to every ping.

Sometimes the Slack app on macOS can become sluggish. This is common when you are logged into multiple workspaces. If the interface feels slow, go to the Help menu and select Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart. This usually resolves most performance issues without requiring a full reinstall.

When project managers post new guidelines in Slack, use the Save for Later feature. This ensures you can find the updated instructions quickly when you start your next shift. Simply hover over the message and click the bookmark icon.
Using Lazur to assist your slack workflow

Lazur helps you stay focused on your evaluation tasks. Instead of hunting for a specific channel or setting, hold the Option and Command keys to ask Lazur where to find a feature. It can point to the correct menu or guide you through a multi-step process like setting up a new notification schedule.

Search engine evaluators are experts at finding information. Apply that skill to Slack. Use modifiers like from:@username to find messages from your project lead or in:#channel to limit your search to a specific project channel. This is much faster than scrolling through history.

faq.question: Can I use Slack on older versions of macOS?
faq.answer: Slack currently requires macOS 14 Sonoma or higher for the latest desktop app versions. If you are on an older OS, you may need to use the web browser version of Slack.

faq.question: How do I clear my Slack cache on Mac?
faq.answer: Go to the Help menu in the top menu bar, select Troubleshooting, and then choose Clear Cache and Restart. The app will close and reopen automatically.

faq.question: What is the fastest way to switch channels in Slack?
faq.answer: Press Command + K to open the quick switcher. Type the first few letters of the channel or person you want to message and press Enter.
